safety: Every case runs against disposable synthetic stores created inside the run's hermetic directories (GUEST_SAVE_DIR / CHRONICLES_STORE_FILE overrides). No case may ever reference, copy, or open a real profile or database.

cases.title: Store whose version cannot be classified refuses to migrate

fixture.why_unversioned: Matches no declared_version and fails every shape probe in the source_version registry.

cases.injected_fault: Preflight P-04 detection runs against the synthetic store above.
cases.required_behavior: Abort before any read-modify-write; emit RUN_FINISHED with final_status ABORTED_UNKNOWN_SOURCE_VERSION; store bytes untouched.

cases.title: Backup copy or hash mismatch aborts with zero mutations

fixture.fault: Simulated ENOSPC during copy, or sha256(backup) != sha256(source), or backup re-parse count mismatch.

cases.injected_fault: B-02/B-03 verification observes a corrupted or truncated backup.
cases.required_behavior: Abort with BACKUP_FAILED; no migration step has run; original store byte-identical to pre-run; .bak quarantined for forensics.

cases.title: Transformer failure mid-step halts and rolls back completed stores

fixture.fault: Step transformer throws on the malformed affix field.

cases.injected_fault: MigrationStep transformer raises after the temp file is staged but before rename commit.
cases.required_behavior: Emit STEP_FAILED then MIGRATION_FAILED; temp output discarded; store rolled back from verified .bak if any earlier step had committed; final_status ROLLED_BACK.

cases.title: Post-migration invariant mismatch discards output and restores backup

fixture.fault: Migrated output drops the inventory item and lowers level to 1.

cases.injected_fault: V-02 count mismatch and V-03 durable-field loss detected on the migrated candidate.
cases.required_behavior: VERIFY_FAILED; migrated candidate discarded; store atomically restored from verified .bak; RollbackEvidence emitted; final_status ROLLED_BACK.

cases.title: Double-apply is refused or provably byte-neutral

fixture.content: token already present from a prior successful verified run; a re-run attempts the same step again

cases.required_behavior: Step records SKIPPED_ALREADY_APPLIED and performs no transform; if any implementation re-transforms anyway, the byte-diff probe flags NON_IDEMPOTENT and the run is rejected.

cases.title: Restore failure quarantines everything and halts for operator review

fixture.backup: synthetic-guest.pre-migration-<run_id>.bak truncated after backup verification (simulated post-verify corruption)

cases.injected_fault: R-02 sha256 re-verification of the .bak fails at rollback time.
cases.required_behavior: ROLLBACK_FAILED; rename both store and .bak to *.quarantine-<run_id>; no further writes; final_status QUARANTINED_ROLLBACK_FAILED; at most one restore retry; question filed.

cases.title: Undeclared durable regression refuses the commit

fixture.fault: Step declares no lossy allowance, yet the heirloom UUID vanished.

cases.required_behavior: DATA_LOSS_DETECTED; halt; rollback; final_status QUARANTINED_DATA_LOSS; evidence itemizes the dropped UUID; question filed.

cases.title: Concurrent run refuses to start

fixture.lock: synthetic-guest.migration-lock owned by a foreign run_id

cases.injected_fault: P-02 finds an existing lock file.
cases.required_behavior: Refuse to run; emit RUN_FINISHED with the conflict detail; touch nothing.
